as_told.title: Hoagland's Dark Mission: NASA as an occult organisation

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book from about 2007 by a writer named Richard Hoagland, called Dark Mission: The Secret History of NASA, NASA being the US space agency. Michels calls it a very controversial book that makes claims like the ones his guests make about Mars and its past. He says it goes as far as describing NASA as an occult, ritualistic organisation, which, if true, would mean the space agency hides a secret side behind its public work.
